Every board has a shape, and you can read it right off the cards. King, seven, deuce... three different suits. No pair, no suit, nothing close together. That's dry. The best anyone can have here is a set. Now pair it up. King, king, four. A paired board lets full houses in... ...even four of a kind. But still no straight, and no flush.

Ace, eight, three... all hearts. That's suited. Any two of the ten hearts that are left make a flush right now. 45 combos.

And the sneaky one. Jack, ten, four, with two hearts. No straight or flush is possible yet. But 55 combos are drawing to a flush... ...and 48 to an open-ended straight.
